summary: The 2017 Women's Hockey Asia Cup was an international field hockey tournament held in Kakamigahara, Gifu, Japan, from 28 October to 5 November 2017 with eight teams. India won the title for the second time, China finished as runner-up, and South Korea took third place. The tournament produced 134 goals over 24 matches, an average of 5.58 per match, with China's Zhong Jiaqi as top scorer with 11 goals.
one_line: The 2017 Women's Hockey Asia Cup, held in Kakamigahara, Japan, was won by India ahead of China and South Korea.
